0001| # Changelog
0002| 
0003| All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
0004| 
0005| The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
0006| and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
0007| 
0008| ## [Unreleased]
0009| 
0010| ### Added
0011| 
0012| - Install the client and a supported engine in one run — the default installation no longer stops at the client. It asks the configured engine source which version it offers, without changing anything, reads the version of an engine already in place, and then decides: an absent engine is obtained, a present engine at or above the client's declared minimum is kept when the offered version is not strictly newer, and a strictly newer offered engine replaces it. An engine at or below the version in place is never installed. The finished state always satisfies the client's declared minimum supported engine version, otherwise the run fails with a message naming the required minimum, the version found or offered, and the action that supplies a satisfying engine. A successful run reports the engine version in place and whether it was installed, kept or replaced. The engine source and the engine's own installer are documented configuration with defaults, `--client-only` installs the client alone without querying or touching any engine, leaving the shell profile unchanged still performs the engine part, removing the client leaves the engine in place, and repeating the default run changes no engine that needs no change. The README documents the combined installation, the client-only installation and the engine source.
0013| 
0014| - Open an interactive session when the client starts with no arguments — `forgel-code` now shows a prompt and stays open instead of printing usage text. A sentence typed at the prompt is handed to the engine's project agent as one free-form request and the agent's answer is shown in the session. The session shows the selected project and lets the owner switch it without leaving, shows a plan as its ordered tasks with their states and a new task with its title and state, and re-reads the task and release state from the engine on its own so progress appears without asking for a status. Accepting a task, sending it back with remarks, retrying a failed task, pausing and resuming work are asked for in plain language, an ambiguous or unmatched request gets a clarification and performs nothing, a failure shows the reason and the next possible step while the session stays usable, and replies follow the language of the owner's message. Adopting a repository, creating a project, secrets and configuration stay explicit separate actions that a sentence never triggers, key material never reaches the screen, and leaving — or the end of the input — ends the session at once. The session adds no capability: every answer and every piece of state still comes from the engine, and every one-shot usage keeps its previous output, exit status and `--json` form.
0015| 
0016| ### Changed
0017| 
0018| - Speed up the suite without weakening a test — the expensive duplicated work is gone instead of a scenario: one read-only checkout copy and one prepared installation per scenario group are shared by the tests that only read them, and the bounded-check cases configure a limit below the product default.
0019| - Remove every statement of a suite completion time, duration or runtime bound from the documentation — the README `## Tests` section still says that one documented command runs the whole suite, that the installer situations are covered by a real installation into a throwaway home location with a real detected login shell, and that a run from a source checkout needs only the Python standard library and no network access, but it no longer promises how long such a run takes.
0020| 
0021| ### Removed
0022| 
0023| - Remove the automated check that read the installation instructions — no check reads a documentation file any more, because documentation is text and is accepted or returned by a person reading it. The check and the data it kept to reproduce the installation commands are gone in full, no automated check of documentation text replaces them, and every other check stays in place. The guard that used to fail the suite when a documented install, update or uninstall command carried an older tag is gone with it, so the three commands stay tied together by review of their text rather than by a check.
0024| 
0025| ### Fixed
0026| 
0027| - Refuse a free-text request to create or change key material, to change configuration and to create or scaffold a project in English and in Russian, including their bare wording — a sentence that names a key without any credential term, the configuration without the word `configuration`, or a project that is scaffolded rather than created is now recognised, refused in the session and never forwarded to the engine, and the refusal states that the action needs the explicit operation and names the client's own `forgel-code` command to use. Ordinary conversation that merely mentions a key, the configuration or a project still reaches the engine unchanged, and every refusal that already existed keeps its wording.
0028| - Mask the value of the French password label when it is written with underscores or hyphens — the label is now recognised as a secret label in its joined spellings as well as its spaced one, in any letter case, so an engine reply or error that carries it next to a value is redacted before display and before retention. Every value form already handled for the spaced label is covered, a joined label without an adjacent value leaves the message unchanged, and every other supported label in every language redacts exactly as before.
0029| - Refuse sensitive explicit actions phrased in French and Spanish as well as in English and Russian — a free-text request to create a project, to set or define a credential such as a password, a token or a key, or to change configuration or settings is recognised in all four languages the session speaks, in either word order, in ordinary inflections and with or without diacritics. The refusal-and-redirect answer speaks the language of the message, states that such an action is never carried out from a sentence, and then points at the client's own explicit command `forgel-code` together with the action it performs — creating a project, setting or defining a password, a token or a key, or changing the configuration — in the same style as the English and Russian refusals. Nothing of the refused request is sent onward, ordinary French and Spanish conversation still reaches the engine unchanged, and English and Russian results stay exactly as they were.
0030| - Mask the credential of a label followed by an ordinary descriptor word — a secret label followed by a word such as `value`, `field` or `string` used to hide that descriptor and leave the credential itself on screen and in the retained state; the descriptor now stays readable and the value, including the one behind a copula or a separator, is replaced by the existing masking placeholder. Sentences that only mention a secret word are still shown unchanged.

0032| - Point the README install, update and uninstall commands at the current `v0.2.0` release installer — the documented commands no longer fetch the stale install script, and all three name one and the same install-script URL.
